_comment: Expected tool count per MCP server, checked by core/scripts/mcp-toolcount.py.
Copy to .claude/rules/mcp-expected.json in the brain and fill in the servers of its .mcp.json.
A deviation in EITHER direction is a finding: a tool that vanished after a move, or one
that was added without being written down. Update this file deliberately, in the same
commit that changes the tool surface. List only servers that start without hardware or
a running application - a server that needs one fails here for the wrong reason.
